message_imported.name: message_imported
message_imported.value: "message"."zendesk_key" is null or ("message"."ticket_id" is not null and "message"."state" = 'processed' and "message"."submission_id" is null and ("message"."direction" = 'in') = ("message"."author_user_id" is null))

message_incoming.name: message_incoming
message_incoming.value: "message"."direction" <> 'in' or "message"."zendesk_key" is not null or ("message"."source_id" is not null and "message"."graph_id" is not null and "message"."folder" is not null and "message"."graph" is not null)

message_written.name: message_written
message_written.value: "message"."direction" = 'in' or "message"."zendesk_key" is not null or (("message"."author_user_id" is not null or "message"."direction" = 'out') and "message"."submission_id" is not null and "message"."ticket_id" is not null and "message"."state" = 'processed')

tracked_link_target.name: tracked_link_target
tracked_link_target.value: ("tracked_link"."kind" = 'url' and "tracked_link"."url" is not null and "tracked_link"."part_id" is null) or ("tracked_link"."kind" = 'file' and "tracked_link"."part_id" is not null and "tracked_link"."url" is null)
